data.narrative:
Defense Unicorns is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Rob Slaughter, Jeff McCoy, and Andrew Greene that has raised $171M to date and carries a current post-money valuation of $1.0B. The peer universe consists of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the same sector and stage—with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $1.0B, implying a forward valuation of $1.9B. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables (Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Twenty at $1.0B, among others) yields a median valuation of $1.2B.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a range of $1.1B to $2.2B, with a median of $1.6B. The primary source of variance stems from the width of peer valuations in the defense sector at Series B stage. The stage-progression method anchors toward the upper end of the range, while peer-median anchors toward the lower end. Key uncertainties include the relevance of public comparables to private market conditions and whether the peer set adequately reflects Defense Unicorns' specific technology positioning and growth trajectory within an inherently dispersed sector.
